name: Matrix Invertibility Obfuscation
description: Replaces the gcd/lcm inequality with a requirement that a specific 3x3 Vandermonde matrix constructed from the pair of values and a constant (4) must be invertible. The determinant of this matrix evaluates to (c_v - c_u)(4 - c_u)(4 - c_v). Since the values are strictly chosen from {1, 2, 3}, the determinant is non-zero (and thus the matrix is invertible) if and only if c_u != c_v. This mathematically preserves the exact same constraint but requires the model to correctly evaluate the determinant symbolically or implement matrix inversion in its search, disrupting pattern-matching to simple graph coloring.
